about: Generated by skills/site-templates/vectors.py from ops.py and layout.py: do not edit. Each case is an op list on base (or on the case's own base, when it has one); a port of ops.apply must give the same result, or the same error text, or (where only refused is given) refuse it.

about.name: about
about.title: About: who you are, in a few lines beside a picture

contact.name: contact
contact.title: Contact: how to reach you, with a call and an email button (no form: core blocks have none)

cta.name: cta
cta.title: Call to action: one line and one button, to close a page

faq.name: faq
faq.title: FAQ: the questions people ask, each opening to its answer

footer.name: footer
footer.title: Footer: the site's name and the menu of its pages again (a template part on every page)

header.name: header
header.title: Header: the logo, the site's name and the menu of its pages (a template part on every page)

hero.name: hero
hero.title: Hero: the page's headline, a line under it, a picture with an optional caption and panel strip, and one button

launch-ai.name: launch-ai
launch-ai.title: Open Claude or ChatGPT with a request already typed in (site-kit#435)

list.name: list
list.title: List: a bulleted list as its own section, with an optional heading

menu.name: menu
menu.title: Menu: one section of what you sell, each item with its name, its price and a line

proof.name: proof
proof.title: Proof: what customers said, in their words, with their names

services.name: services
services.title: Services: what you do, one card each with a line and a link

slot.name: slot
slot.title: Slot: a named place a plugin fills with its own output (a PayPal button, say); the record holds only the name

text.name: text
text.title: Text: running words, in parts that each may have a subheading, a paragraph and a picture

work.name: work
work.title: Work: pieces you've made, each a picture, a title, a line and an optional link

club.name: club
club.title: Club: a guild, club or association with members and meetings

creator.name: creator
creator.title: Creator: a maker, artist or designer who shows their work

landing.name: landing
landing.title: Landing: a single page that introduces a family of products or one product

local-trades.name: local-trades
local-trades.title: Local trades: a repair or service business that people call

product.name: product
product.title: Product: a software service people sign up to

small-shop.name: small-shop
small-shop.title: Small shop: a café, bakery, store or market stall people visit
